neighbours.label: the word 'multipath' (its second piece 'ath'), as in multipath propagation and interference in radio and GPS signals
fire: Urban cell towers must cope with strong multipath caused by tall glass buildings.
Our receiver uses a rake design to combine the multipath copies of the signal.
In dense forests the GPS fix wanders because of multipath from tree trunks.
Engineers measured how multipath fading changed as the train entered the tunnel.
OFDM was chosen largely because it tolerates multipath delay spread well.
The surveyor raised the antenna to reduce multipath errors near the metal shed.
Wi-Fi in the warehouse was unreliable until the team modelled the multipath channel.
Radar returns over the sea are distorted by multipath off the water surface.
quiet: Urban cell towers must cope with strong interference caused by tall glass buildings.
Our receiver uses a rake design to combine the delayed copies of the signal.
In dense forests the GPS fix wanders because of reflections from tree trunks.
Engineers measured how signal fading changed as the train entered the tunnel.
OFDM was chosen largely because it tolerates long echo delays well.
The surveyor raised the antenna to reduce ranging errors near the metal shed.
Wi-Fi in the warehouse was unreliable until the team modelled the radio channel.
Radar returns over the sea are distorted by bounces off the water surface.

notes: Card top example is 'multip|ath' at -53.75, far above the rest (salt water, chloride, reverberation ~10-18). Probe: two multipath sentences ~0.59, 'salt spray' 0.25, 'propagation' 0.08.
